# IOTHS

> IOTHS is an offline-first app for iPhone and iPad in which a checklist inside a note becomes a task on a kanban board built for one person. Each note is a portable `.md` file with YAML frontmatter, and no IOTHS account is required.

## Product facts

- Platforms: iPhone and iPad, requiring iOS 18.0 or iPadOS 18.0 or later.
- Core workflow: write notes, add Markdown checklists, view open tasks together, and organize note cards or individual tasks on a kanban board with a configurable work-in-progress limit.
- File format: UTF-8 Markdown files with YAML frontmatter; compatible with an existing Markdown notes library, including the structure used by Obsidian.
- Capture: typing, dictation, camera, Share Extension, and on-device PDF-to-Markdown conversion.
- Privacy: notes remain on the device unless the user explicitly activates a storage or sync destination. Optional usage analytics never include note content, titles, or tags.
- Free features: capture, editing, reading, sharing, PDF conversion, tagging, task tracking, archive, and trash recovery.
- Full Unlock: a one-time in-app purchase, not a subscription. It adds Files-folder, GitHub, GitLab, and OneDrive storage plus portable ZIP export.
- Developer: Bedrock Rebellion.
